svg.title: Step 4: Glyph ramp
svg.desc: Brightness from 0 to 255 is divided into equal buckets, one per character in the ramp, ordered dark to light.
svg.text: Brightness of every cell in this render. The bar at 0 is black space and runs off the chart.
here n = 6, so every bucket is 42 wide (the last takes the remainder)
MATCH THE RAMP TO THE GROUND
